redfin.remarks: A Longtime Family Home Ready for Its Next Chapter For more than 40 years, this charming traditional home has been held by the same family, and now it’s ready to welcome its next owner. Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 bath, the home sits on a generous approximately 6,700 sq. ft. lot, offering wonderful possibilities to refresh, personalize, or create a space that truly feels like your own. The location adds to the appeal, with a walkable setting and convenient access to shopping, dining and everyday amenities. Entertainment and recreation are also close at hand, with SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater just minutes away. There’s something special about a home that has remained in one family for decades. Whether you’re drawn to its traditional character, the generous lot , or the opportunity to bring your own vision to the property, this is a home with plenty of potential for its next chapter. Estate sale. Property is being sold in its present as-is condition.
